name: Ijuuin Rei
source:
A popular boy at Kirameki High. His upper class background and attention from the female students because of his good looks makes him have an vain and snobby disposition.

[spoiler]The truth is however, is that he is actually a woman dressing up as a man due to it being apart of her family's traditions.[/spoiler]
